title: I made a CLI so AI agents stop making a mess of Godot scenes
author: EdMUK
selftext:
Most LLMs are bad at editing Godot projects. They build UI in GDScript at runtime so nothing shows in the editor, or they hand-write .tscn files and get resource IDs and load\_steps wrong.

godot-cli edits .tscn, .tres and project.godot files from the command line without opening Godot. The output matches what the editor saves byte for byte, so you get clean scenes you can still tweak by hand. It has an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and OpenCode, a validator for broken paths and IDs, and a `project run` command so the agent can check its own work.

It’s a single binary, MIT licensed, and runs on Linux, macOS and Windows. It doesn’t read binary .scn or .res files yet.

[https://unabated-games.github.io/godot-cli/](https://unabated-games.github.io/godot-cli/)

Happy to answer questions.
